title: feat(security)!: View All and Modify All stop opening fields; viewAllFields is the one every-field bit
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-alice"} -->
_Requested by **Alice** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePH?thread=cmsg_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePHV51tYVEf6EoB92QzbNcTG5)_

Fixes #36055

Draft. #37314 has merged (protocol 19, `step19`); this branch merged main and carries both halves: the 19 field-axis switch and the ADR-0087 conversion with ruling A's exclusions.

## Maintainer quick read

- From 19.0.0, View All (`viewAllRecords`) and Modify All (`modifyAllRecords`) widen records only. They cast no field vote. `viewAllFields` is the only "every field" channel: read only, never edit, and a set's own `readable: false` row beats it.
- Error direction: an unconverted set sees fewer fields, never more. No hidden field opens.
- Stored permission sets (Studio-saved) are read with the 19 meaning, never rewritten (ruling A, comment 7177446075). Source sets get `viewAllFields: true` from `os migrate meta --from 18 --write`. Studio has no `viewAllFields` control today, so a stored set is fixed by adding `viewAllFields: true` through the metadata API; a review list of affected stored sets is follow-up #37375.
- Beyond the card's premise: Modify All's cross-set EDIT re-open is lost too, because `viewAllFields` votes read only. That includes the built-in admin beside an app set's edit lock (it still reads every field). This is the ruled field-axis split (ruling 6912661484); the D3 entry names it.
- Beside Modify All, a set's own field rows now bind on both halves: its own `readable: false` row hides that field from its holders even with `viewAllFields: true`, and its own field row without `editable: true` no longer edits it. The D3 entry's one-step check and the changeset state both, with the fix for each (delete the own hide row; write `editable: true` on the row).

## What changes

- `@objectstack/core`: `superuserFieldVote` is replaced by `viewAllFieldsReadVote(sets, object, field)`. `buildEffectiveFieldPermissions` asks it. `holdsSuperuserBypass` is unchanged and answers the record bypass only.
- `@objectstack/plugin-security`: `getFieldPermissions` asks the same vote. Explain drops the "superseded by the Modify All Data field vote" branch (and `ConditionedFieldEntry.supersededBy`): a row-conditioned lock binds per row for every caller.
- `@objectstack/lint`: `security-superuser-field-mask-inert` is retired (constant, catalog text, explanation, export). `security-cross-set-field-reopen` reports only a hidden field another set's `viewAllFields` re-opens, in all 11 locales. The controlled-by-parent master-reference rule and the roll-up source-visibility rules no longer skip a mask beside Modify All.
- `@objectstack/scenarios`: persona-grant scoring no longer treats Modify All as overriding a field lock.
- `@objectstack/spec`:
  - `viewAllRecords` / `modifyAllRecords` / `viewAllFields` descriptions state the new meaning (generated reference docs regenerated). The liveness ledger anchors `viewAllFields` at `#viewAllFieldsReadVote`.
  - New ADR-0087 D2 conversion `permission-view-all-fields-beside-record-bypass` (`packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/19/`): writes `viewAllFields: true` on every `objects` entry, `'*'` included, that has `viewAllRecords: true` or `modifyAllRecords: true` and no `viewAllFields` (an authored `viewAllFields: false` is left alone). A default flip: `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '18.6.0'`, fixture with 3 notices. Registered in a new `MAJOR_19_CONVERSIONS` (the sorted `{ conversion, order }` shape of major 18) as `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR[19]`; `step19.conversionIds` derives from it.
  - New D3 semantic entry `permission-view-all-modify-all-cast-no-field-vote` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`): every behaviour change, ruling A's one-step operator check with both own-row cases beside Modify All (an own `readable: false` row keeps hiding its field after the bit is added; an own field row without `editable: true` loses the edit), the source and stored paths, and the error direction. It says where the conversion replays: the authoring funnel skips it (retired from the load path), and the artifact door and the stored-row seam refuse it by id. It judges the conversion's edits (`conversionIds`).
  - `ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES` (`identity/eval-user.zod.ts`): the comment on its `'*'` `viewAllFields: true` states the 19 meaning (the bit, not the record bits, keeps the platform administrator reading every field; it votes read, never edit). Comment only.
  - Ruling A, stored rows: `applyConversionsToStoredItem` refuses the id by name (module-local `STORED_ROWS_NOT_REWRITTEN`, merged into any caller's `excludeConversionIds`), so the database loader, the ObjectQL stored-row read, the metadata-protocol read and `os migrate meta --stored` never rewrite a stored set.
- `@objectstack/metadata-core`: the artifact-ingestion door refuses the id (`DEFAULT_FLIPS_NOT_REPLAYED_HERE`, docblock extended with its reason).
- Showcase: `showcase_auditor` (four View All entries) and ops' `showcase_announcement` Modify All entry carry `viewAllFields: true`, migrated by hand; the access-matrix snapshot records the five grants (the build's ADR-0090 D6 drift check named them).
- Docs: field-level-security, authorization, permissions-matrix and the showcase security tour describe the 19 meaning.
- Changeset: names the conversion id (ADR-0087 marker), the one-step check with both own-row cases beside Modify All, the stored-set reading and the D3 entry; `@objectstack/metadata-core` added as `minor`.

## Where the 19 upgrade guidance lives

- D3 entry: `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.permission-view-all-modify-all-cast-no-field-vote.ts`.
- Generated guide: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:upgrade-guide` writes `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/19.md` (gitignored, built by the docs site, served at `/docs/protocol-upgrade/19`): the conversion row and the D3 entry, both saying stored sets are read with the 19 meaning and the fix is `viewAllFields: true`.
- Changeset: `.changeset/36055-view-all-stops-voting-on-fields.md` (ships as `CHANGELOG.md`).

## Why

Card #36055, step 3 of the field-axis split (#34365, ruling of record 6912661484): View All / Modify All widen records, `viewAllFields` reads fields.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/19/permission-view-all-fields-beside-record-bypass.test.ts` (10 tests): registration and step-19 wiring, the three rewrite sites and their notices, entries left alone, field rows untouched, idempotence, the authoring funnel never replays it, the stored seam refuses it for both row spellings and a caller cannot opt back in, a firing control, and other retired entries still replay over a stored permission row.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion.test.ts`: a new block, six tests: refused inside the floor window, after the strict parse, inside the per-entry window and the major-step half; a shut window; a firing control.
- `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`: a `semantic` row kind joins a default flip to the D3 entry an author meets (a default flip has no tombstone or refusal); it reads the entry's `reason` and `acceptanceCriteria`, which name protocol 19 and `--from 18`.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance measurement (one-shot script, not committed): pre-PR sources under the v18 merge vs the same sources converted, under the v19 merge, every single set and every pair. Built-in default sets alone: 9 sets, 45 combinations, 507 field cells, 0 conversion notices (their `'*'` entries already carry the bit), read 507/507 and edit 507/507 identical. Showcase + default sets: 18 sets, 171 combinations, 1314 cells, 5 conversion notices; read 1314/1314 identical; edit 1302/1314, the 12 differences all ruled (`admin_full_access` / `organization_admin` beside `showcase_contributor` / `showcase_client_liaison` no longer edit `showcase_project.budget` / `spent` / `budget_remaining`, which those sets lock). CRM + default sets: 11 sets, 66 combinations, 663 cells, all identical. No cell opened a field or an edit. The conversion of the pre-PR showcase source equals the branch's hand migration on all 9 sets. Control: an unconverted View All set beside a set hiding a field reads it under v18 (`readable: true`) and not under v19 (`readable: false`).
- Other seams checked: the flow-only exclusions (`CONVERSIONS_NOT_REPLAYED_AT_REHYDRATION`, `FLOW_FALLBACK_VERDICT_NOT_REPLAYED`) never see a permission set; every stored-row caller (database loader, ObjectQL, metadata-protocol, `os migrate meta --stored`, translation and datasource rows) goes through `applyConversionsToStoredItem`; the only other `includeRetired` caller is the artifact door. No seam outside the two edited ones replays this id.
- Mechanical consequences outside the card's listed surface, all test or fixture data: the major-18 fixture `permission-modify-all-allow-delete-false-to-true` carries `viewAllFields: true` beside its Modify All entries so the fixture table stays disjoint; `scripts/conversions-major18-merge.test.ts` reads major 18's slice of `ALL_CONVERSIONS` instead of its tail; the retired-key pin row above; the showcase access-matrix snapshot.
- Ablation (one-shot): removing the id from `STORED_ROWS_NOT_REWRITTEN` turns 3 stored-seam tests red; removing it from `DEFAULT_FLIPS_NOT_REPLAYED_HERE` turns 4 door tests red; both restored byte-identical to `HEAD` (blob hashes matched, `git diff HEAD` empty). The first stored-seam attempt was refused by the replacement tool (its marker already occurred in the file) and changed nothing; it was rerun with a distinct marker.
- The major-step leg of the door block expects `authored-current` while the permission flip is step 19's only retired entry: the refusal leaves nothing for that half to open.

## Verification

## ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ end-state note (text for the weekly ADR card #37245)

> **Note (19.0.0): View All and Modify All cast no field vote (#36055, step 3 of the field-axis split #34365, ruling of record 6912661484).** A set's `viewAllRecords` or `modifyAllRecords` on an object widens which records it reaches and casts no vote in either field merge. The one object-wide field vote is `viewAllFields`: `readable: true` on every field of the object, never `editable: true`, and a set's own explicit `readable: false` row on a field beats its own bit (the note of 2026-11-15, now carried by `viewAllFields` alone). Both merges ask one function, `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts#viewAllFieldsReadVote`. Consequences: a set's own field rows bind beside its own View All or Modify All; another set's View All or Modify All re-opens no hidden or locked field; nothing re-opens a field edit lock across sets (the built-in admin sets read every field through their `'*'` `viewAllFields` and no longer edit a field another held set locks). The ADR-0087 conversion `permission-view-all-fields-beside-record-bypass` adds `viewAllFields: true` beside the bits in source; it is a default flip, refused by id at the artifact door and at stored-row reads, so stored sets take this meaning on upgrade (ruling A on #36055). `security-superuser-field-mask-inert` is retired; `security-cross-set-field-reopen` reports the `viewAllFields` re-open only.
